company.name: Raycast
company.shortDescription: Raycast is a Productivity Tools company that provides a command bar software to assist developers control their tools as well as AI tools.
company.description: Raycast is a developer of a command bar software intended to assist developers to control their tools. The company's software offers a search bar to quickly search commands and the built-in store to discover and install extensions such as Jira or GitHub, enabling clients to make easy access to various applications.

productsAndServices.description: A keyboard-driven launcher for accessing applications, files, system controls, scripts, notes, calculations, window management, and integrated third-party tools.
productsAndServices.name: Raycast

productsAndServices.description: An operating-system-integrated AI assistant for web-enabled questions, conversational help, and custom AI commands that automate repetitive tasks.
productsAndServices.name: Raycast AI

productsAndServices.description: A paid Raycast subscription tier that extends the core launcher with additional productivity and AI capabilities.
productsAndServices.name: Raycast Pro

productsAndServices.description: A marketplace for discovering and installing extensions that add commands and integrations for productivity, engineering, design, writing, and other workflows.
productsAndServices.name: Raycast Store

productsAndServices.description: A development platform for building and publishing Raycast extensions using React, TypeScript, Node.js, and Raycast’s built-in UI components.
productsAndServices.name: Raycast Extension API

productsAndServices.description: An organizational Raycast offering for deploying and managing Raycast usage across teams.
productsAndServices.name: Raycast Teams
